summary: Directories, JSON IDs, command IDs and project names are English; stable capability names are StageGate and ArchitectureConformance, generic V3 project names carry no project prefix, and project prefixes derive only from the profile project ID.
rationale: User answer to Plan 06 D6. Tool brands such as ArchUnitNET or LayerGuard describe implementations that section 20 intends to replace, so they must not become stable identities; provenance documents still record implementation origin. Plan 06 section 17 D6; review R6.
